description: Purpose: ASTM spec parameter ranges (min/max/unit/test method) for native carbon black grades N110-N990, conductive benchmarks and rCB grades - the standard-parameters reference for carbon black. Guidelines: pass grade (e.g. n330, n550) plus optional type (native/conductive/rcb); use to judge whether an rCB sample falls in spec (iodine absorption, OAN, SAOAN, ash, pH). Limits: spec ranges only - not lot-specific CoA data. Ex: 'N330 standard parameters', 'rCB N550 spec vs ASTM'.

grade.description: 牌号或实体 ID，如 N550 / rcb-grade-n550

text.description: Human-readable result (markdown, or a JSON string when response_format=json).
